content:
oliver: CI nightly eval flagged a regression on the longform-coherence suite for model: redwood-open-7b-q4_2026. Drop is ~7.8 pts on coherence@512 vs yesterday. Alert: HIGH severity.
oliver: Suites failed: longform-coherence, hallucination-check (minor), context-clip (medium). See summary in the alert payload below.
ciara-bot: [ALERT] nightly-eval:redwood-open-7b-q4_2026 - coherence delta -7.8. Started: 2026-03-20T06:40:12Z. Links: https://ci.internal/redwood/evals/1795124832
maya: noted. First suspicion: quantization pass (q4) changes in the bring-up. We landed a kernel tweak in runtime last night too.
maya: can you paste a couple failing prompts? need repro to see if it's generation style or scoring change.
sasha: attaching one failing exemplar from the suite: "Prompt: Summarize the policy memo focusing on tradeoffs. Reference length 420 tokens." Expected: concise structured summary. Got: meandering list with factual hallucinations.
oliver: thanks. I ran a quick local reproducer with the exact checkpoint and q4 config: reproduces the meandering output. So likely not eval scoring flake.
juan: I will check runtime kernel selection + fused attention path that rolled yesterday. If the runtime falls back to less-accurate kernel for certain sequence shapes it could change token-level sampling.
juan: also verify whether smart-routing sent eval traffic to fallback GPU pool with older driver.
maya: can you run diff on logits between fp16 baseline and q4? a small script:
```
python tools/logit_diff.py --model redwood-open-7b --ckpt q4_2026 --prompts samples.json --save diffs.json
```
run on same random seed, greedy seed fixed.
oliver: ran the logit diff quickly — see top-3 token probs shift in many steps; KL divergence per-token spikes around 0.04 avg across sequences (higher than expected). I captured examples in /tmp/eval-diffs-1795124832.log
maya: that KL jump is suspicious. Could be from quantize rounding or from the new kernel's matrix multiply ordering. If we can isolate whether quantization or kernel causes it, we'll know the rollback plan.
sasha: initial severity set to HIGH because customer-facing demo uses this prompt family. We should flag customer impact.
juan: plan: (1) run the same reproducer with previous runtime (rollback kernel) but same q4 checkpoint; (2) run q4 checkpoint on previous runtime; (3) run fp16 checkpoint on new runtime. This triangulates whether quant or kernel is primary. I'll start step (1) now.
maya: I'll start deeper eval on the suite with a larger sample and produce per-prompt regression heatmap. ETA 60m.
oliver: owners: maya -> lead investigation and write regression note; juan -> runtime kernel triage; sasha -> customer impact comms if SLA thresholds hit.
ciara-bot: Action created: TICKET-ML-1298 "nightly: redwood-open-7b-q4 coherence regression" assigned to maya, priority P1.
oliver: quick mitigation idea: pin eval routing to fp16 variant until we understand. That buys time for diagnosis. Thoughts?
juan: agree. I can add a routing rule to prefer fp16 for the eval job queue. Will do and post deploy id.
maya: once I have heatmap I'll propose a rollback window or targeted kernel patch.
sasha: will prepare a one-line internal blurb for #eng and a short customer note template.
oliver: thanks team. Please update thread with reproducer links and the kernel-deploy id. We'll regroup in 45m. :thumbsup:
